decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the core portfolio and kept its own page through 2024, which signals satisfactory results in a growing industry. Management therefore has no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The folding add-on has a documented customer installation running crease, perforate, cut and fold in one pass, and it stayed on the website in 2024. It fits the firm's inline automation direction, so management judges it to meet aspirations and keeps it despite the firm's active pruning of other 2023 launches.
